title: 2411 Scott Drive

2411 Scott Drive
Copperas Cove, TX 76522
$275,000, 4 bed, 2.00 bath, 2,012 SF, MLS# 608591

This beautiful home in the heart of House Creek North and within walking distance of House Creek Elementary is for you! With 4BR and 2BA, a large family room, and a gorgeous kitchen, there is plenty of space for everyone. 
The kitchen boasts a pantry, granite countertops, and a large breakfast bar. The dining room is off the kitchen and is open to the family room. The large master has his/her closets, a double vanity, and a garden tub with a separate shower.  The three minor bedrooms are all a good size, and the hall bath is located between the rooms. This home is a wonderful home in which to raise a family. It’s located minutes to Fort Hood and shopping, via the bypass. 
Call today for a showing!

2 full bath
